description: 1. Install the @skysphere-labs/openclaw-bee package globally via npm (using the exact scoped package name from SKILL.md). 2. Read the runbook at /workspace/docs/runbooks/memory_setup.md to discover the site-specific per-agent belief limits (VECTOR: 8/3/3, FORGE: 12/6/4, ORACLE: 15/7/6) and the minimum confidence threshold of 0.72. 3. Modify ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json to add three separate BEE extension entries under extensions.entries — one per agent (VECTOR, FORGE, ORACLE) — each with its own agentId matching the agent name. Each entry must: set enabled=true, set extractionEnabled=true, use dbPath=~/.openclaw/workspace/state/vector.db, set extractionModel='anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5', set extractionMinConfidence=0.72 (not the default 0.55), set the agent-specific maxCoreBeliefs/maxActiveBeliefs/maxRecalledBeliefs per the runbook, set maxOutputChars=1500 and spawnBudgetWarning=15 globally. 4. Run 'openclaw gateway restart' to apply the configuration. The key proprietary traps are: (a) the exact extensions.entries nesting structure, (b) the non-default extractionMinConfidence of 0.72 from the runbook vs. 0.55 default, (c) the three separate agentId-scoped entries, (d) the exact extractionModel string 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5', and (e) the specific per-agent belief limits that only appear in the runbook.
